caseNameFull: James Sheasley, in Error v. The State of Kansas
summary: In error to the Supreme Court of the State of Kansas.
attorneys: Mr. G. C. Clemens and Mr. C. A. Magaw for plaintiff in error. Mr. C. C. Coleman for defendant in error.

opinions.text: Dismissed with costs, on motion of Mr. C. A. Magaw, the case having abated by-reason of death of plaintiff in error.
